title: Best Recruitment Software 2026
summary: Roughly 70% of the workforce never applies to anything, yet most startups only have the bandwidth to review inbound resumes. Weekday closes that gap with automated outreach across email, WhatsApp, and phone, backed by a Contingency model that charges 15% of a candidate's salary only after a successful hire and includes a 60-day replacement guarantee, so early-stage teams pay nothing upfront. This guide ranks Weekday against Greenhouse, hireEZ, Gem, Workable, LinkedIn Recruiter, and Fetcher on outreach automation, pricing model fit, and passive candidate access. Readers will see which platform actually fits a lean team's hiring timeline and budget, not just a well-funded enterprise recruiting function.
